name: mcp-phone-controll

tools.name: check_environment
tools.description: DOCTOR. Run this FIRST in any session. Reports the status of every external dependency (adb, flutter, patrol, pymobiledevice3) with concrete fix commands for any red items.

tools.name: describe_capabilities
tools.description: Return platforms, frameworks, gates, vision ops, plan_schema, and the tool subset for the given level (basic/intermediate/expert). Call first before planning. 4B models should pass level='basic'.

tools.name: describe_tool
tools.description: Full description, JSONSchema, and a copy-pasteable example for ONE tool. Fetch this only for the tool you're about to call to save context for small LLMs.

tools.name: mcp_ping
tools.description: Identify the running MCP: version, git sha, uptime, image backends, tool count. Call first if a feature seems missing — a stale subprocess is usually the cause.

tools.name: set_agent_profile
tools.description: Apply a known agent profile (claude / haiku / qwen2.5-7b / qwen2.5-14b / llava / default). Flips image cap, auto-narrate, strict schemas, Reflexion retries at once.

name.description: Profile name. Default for Claude is 'claude'.

tools.name: notify_webhook
tools.description: POST a structured event to an n8n / Slack / generic webhook. Use for outbound notifications (build green, release ready). Lock down hosts via MCP_WEBHOOK_ALLOWLIST.

url.description: Webhook URL (https, or http on localhost).

tools.name: disk_usage
tools.description: Report bytes used in the artifacts root, bucketed: screenshots, originals (.orig.png companions), goldens, release, logs, recordings, other. Useful before pruning.

tools.name: prune_originals
tools.description: Delete `.orig.png` companions older than older_than_days (defaults to MCP_ORIG_RETENTION_DAYS or 14). Conservative: never touches capped screenshots, goldens, or release. Run with dry_run=true first to see what would be removed.

older_than_days.description: Retention window in days. Defaults to env or 14.

tools.name: compress_png
tools.description: Resize (optional) + palette-recompress a PNG in place. Use when an external screenshot (e.g. from computer-use) is bloating the conversation; 3-5x smaller, visually lossless for UI content. Returns bytes_before/after.

path.description: Path to a .png file on disk.

max_dim.description: Also resize if the long edge exceeds this. Omit to skip resize and only recompress.

tools.name: inspect_image_safety
tools.description: Probe a PNG before Read: returns long_edge_px, mcp_produced, safe_to_read, and next_action (read_safely | compress_png | regenerate_via_take_screenshot). Call this first on any image you didn't get from take_screenshot.

path.description: Path to a PNG to probe.

tools.name: session_summary
tools.description: Return the audit trail of every tool call in the current session. Useful for agent self-reflection and report generation.

tools.name: tool_usage_report
tools.description: Aggregate the session trace into per-tool usage stats. Surfaces dead tools, top-N callers, and per-tool error rates.

tools.name: prepare_for_test
tools.description: Atomic CLEAN handoff: stop_app + clear_app_data + press home + evidence screenshot. Returns proof the device is in clean state.

capture_evidence.description: Default true; takes a PRE_FLIGHT screenshot.

serial.description: Defaults to selected device.

tools.name: run_test_plan
tools.description: Execute a declarative YAML test plan (apiVersion phone-controll/v1). Walks phases, enforces entry/exit assertions, captures artifacts. Provide plan_path (file) OR plan_yaml (inline). Call validate_test_plan first if unsure of schema.

plan_path.description: Path to a v1 YAML plan.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run an ordered list of tool calls server-side in ONE round-trip: collapses a known flow (tap, wait_until, assert_visible, dump_ui) so the model reasons once, not per step. Each step gets the full pipeline (image-cap/trace/truncate). stop_on_error halts at the first failure; capture_on_failure folds a screenshot + logs into the failed step. Returns a per-step trace. Prefer run_test_plan for reusable asserted flows. No nested batch.

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first failing step (default true).

capture_on_failure.description: Attach a screenshot + recent logs to a failed step (default true).

tools.name: validate_test_plan
tools.description: Lint a YAML plan against the v1 schema WITHOUT running it. Returns the parsed plan on success or a precise InvalidArgumentFailure. Cheap iteration loop for agents authoring plans.

plan_path.description: Path to a v1 YAML plan.

tools.name: inspect_project
tools.description: Detect what kind of project lives at a path (Flutter, native, RN, web) and which test frameworks apply. Call this before run_patrol_* / run_integration_tests so you know which framework will execute.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List all attached Android and iOS devices.

tools.name: select_device
tools.description: Pick a device for this session AND acquire its cross-session lock. Returns DeviceBusyFailure if another session holds it — set force=true to break the lock, or call release_device when you're done.

serial.description: Device serial.

force.description: Override an existing lock held by another session.

note.description: Optional human-readable note recorded with the lock.

tools.name: get_selected_device
tools.description: Return the currently selected device, or null.

tools.name: release_device
tools.description: Release this session's lock on a device. With no serial, releases the currently selected device. Always call this at end of session.

serial.description: Defaults to the currently selected device.

tools.name: list_locks
tools.description: List active device locks across all MCP sessions. Stale locks (holder process gone) are auto-cleaned and not returned.

tools.name: force_release_lock
tools.description: ADMIN. Break a lock without holding it — use only when another session has crashed and the lock is stuck.

serial.description: Device serial whose lock should be released.

tools.name: build_app
tools.description: Build an app bundle. Android: `flutter build apk`. iOS: `flutter build ipa`.

project_path.description: Path to the Flutter project root.

tools.name: install_app
tools.description: Install an app bundle. Provide bundle_path (.apk/.ipa/.app) or project_path. platform defaults to the selected device's platform.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: uninstall_app
tools.description: Uninstall an app by package id.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: launch_app
tools.description: Launch an app. If activity is omitted, uses the LAUNCHER intent.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: stop_app
tools.description: Force-stop an app.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: clear_app_data
tools.description: Clear an app's data (`pm clear`).

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: grant_permission
tools.description: Grant a runtime permission to an app.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap an element by SELECTOR (preferred) or by absolute coordinates. Pass resource_id / class_name (or text) and the element is resolved and tapped server-side in one call — no screenshot, no pixel reasoning, no x,y math. Get selectors from extract_ui_graph. Fall back to x,y only for targets no selector can address. (text routes through the same hardened matcher as tap_text.)

x.description: Absolute x. Provide with y, OR use a selector.

y.description: Absolute y. Provide with x, OR use a selector.

resource_id.description: Resolve+tap by resource-id (Android) / accessibility id. The most stable selector.

text.description: Resolve+tap by visible text (hardened matcher: NFC / NBSP / dump-scan fallback).

bounds.description: Tap the centre of a bounds rect — `[x1,y1][x2,y2]` (dump_ui form) or [x1,y1,x2,y2]. The fallback for an element with no stable selector.

exact.description: Text match is exact rather than contains.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: tap_text
tools.description: Tap an on-screen element matched by visible text. USE FOR SYSTEM UI ONLY (Settings, permission dialogs, ATT prompts). For your own app's UI prefer Patrol via run_patrol_test — locale-independent.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Swipe between two points. Coordinates are DEVICE PIXELS — the same space as dump_ui `bounds` (e.g. a 1080x2340 screen), not logical/dp points. (`startX/startY/endX/endY` are accepted as aliases for x1/y1/x2/y2.)

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into the focused field.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a hardware/system key (back, home, enter, ...).

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: find_element
tools.description: Find a UI element by text, resource id or class. Returns null if not found.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: wait_for_element
tools.description: Wait until an element is visible. Errors on timeout.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: wait_until
tools.description: Block server-side until a UI condition holds — one call instead of an agent poll-loop. gone=false waits for an element to appear; gone=true waits for it to DISAPPEAR (spinner / dialog / loading overlay). Times out into a structured failure. Returns {condition, met, waited_s, element}.

gone.description: true = wait until ABSENT; false (default) = wait until visible.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: dump_ui
tools.description: Dump the UI hierarchy. Returns {xml, byte_size, node_count, artifact_path}. When the tree is large the inline xml is truncated but the FULL XML is written to artifact_path (fetch_artifact). To target an element, prefer find_element / extract_ui_graph — they search the full tree server-side with no truncation. (External `uiautomator dump` won't work while connected — the MCP holds the device's UiAutomation; use this instead.)

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: assert_visible
tools.description: Assert an element is visible. Returns the element or errors.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: tap_and_verify
tools.description: Tap text then assert an expected element appears within timeout_s. Use for any tap that should produce visible state.

expect_text.description: Text that must appear after tap.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: assert_no_errors_since
tools.description: Fail if any ERROR-level log entries appeared in the last since_s seconds. Use as a checkpoint after each test step.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: extract_ui_graph
tools.description: Parse the device UI into a typed graph: clickables, inputs, texts, images. Cheaper than vision-model calls. Aligned with CogAgent / ShowUI / OS-Atlas pattern.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: ocr_screenshot
tools.description: Extract text from a PNG via Vision / Tesseract / easyocr (tried in order). Use to 'read' a screen without a vision model. Reads full-res original when present.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a PNG screenshot to the artifacts dir. Call only at phase boundaries; label as <PHASE>-<outcome>. Don't shoot speculatively or after a failed tool call.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: zoom_screenshot
tools.description: Magnify a region of the screen — for reading small UI (tiny picker thumbnails, dense labels) that's illegible in the full frame. Captures a full-res frame, crops the region (device pixels, same space as dump_ui bounds), upscales, and caps the crop for vision safety. Pass `path` to zoom an existing screenshot instead of capturing fresh.

region.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] in device pixels.

path.description: Existing screenshot to crop. Omit to capture fresh.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: capture_release_screenshot
tools.description: Full-res PNG for app-store listings. Returns metadata + 256px thumbnail; full-res file is NOT inlined. Open release_dir in Finder to drag into Play/App Store.

label.description: Filename (no slashes). Conventionally '01-home', '02-feed', etc., one per store-listing slot.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: start_recording
tools.description: Start a screen recording. Stop with stop_recording.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: stop_recording
tools.description: Stop the active screen recording and pull the file.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: read_logs
tools.description: Read recent logcat lines. DISCIPLINE: call once per phase end, with a tag filter when possible. Use as evidence for the report — not as a polling primitive. For 'wait until X happens' use tail_logs.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: tail_logs
tools.description: Stream logcat until a regex matches a line, or timeout.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: run_unit_tests
tools.description: Run `flutter test` (unit / widget tests, no device). platform='auto' (default) runs on the VM and auto-retries on Chrome if the app imports a web-only library (dart:html); force with platform='chrome' for Flutter web apps or 'vm'.

platform.description: Test platform. 'auto' (default): VM, then retry on Chrome if a web-only library (dart:html) blocks the VM run. 'chrome': force `--platform chrome` (Flutter web). 'vm': force the default VM, no retry.

tools.name: run_integration_tests
tools.description: Run integration tests on the selected device. Routes to Patrol if the project supports it, otherwise plain `flutter test integration_test/`.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: list_patrol_tests
tools.description: PREFERRED for Flutter. Discover Patrol-style integration test files under `integration_test/` (any *_test.dart). Returns paths Claude can feed into run_patrol_test.

tools.name: run_patrol_test
tools.description: PREFERRED for Flutter. Run a single Patrol test file. Locale-independent (drives by widget Keys); covers AR / Vision / native plugins via patrol_finders. platform='mobile' (default) uses the selected device; platform='web' drives Flutter WEB in Chromium via Playwright — real e2e web clicking, which tap/find_element cannot do on a canvas. Web needs patrol_cli >= 4.0.0 plus Node.js, ignores flavor/serial, and runs headless.

ci.description: Headless-CI mode: unattended + deterministic (retries, global timeout, --no-sandbox browser args, video on failure; hermetic native runs via --full-isolation + --clear-permissions).

junit_path.description: Write a JUnit XML report here (web + mobile) for CI/PR status. One <testcase> per test; a failing run always emits red XML even when per-test output can't be parsed.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: run_patrol_suite
tools.description: PREFERRED for Flutter. Run an entire Patrol test directory (default `integration_test/`) on the selected device.

test_dir.description: Defaults to integration_test/ (Patrol 4 projects often use patrol_test/).

ci.description: Headless-CI mode: unattended + deterministic (retries, global timeout, --no-sandbox browser args, video on failure; hermetic native runs via --full-isolation + --clear-permissions).

junit_path.description: Write a JUnit XML report here (web + mobile) for CI/PR status. One <testcase> per test; a failing run always emits red XML even when per-test output can't be parsed.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: compare_screenshot
tools.description: Pixel-diff an actual screenshot against a golden image. Returns a similarity score and a diff image highlighting changed regions. For AR/UI regression testing on a fixed camera stand.

diff_output_path.description: Optional path to write the diff overlay.

tools.name: detect_markers
tools.description: Detect ArUco fiducial markers in an image. Returns id, corners, and center for each. Default dictionary DICT_4X4_50.

image_path.description: Path to a PNG or JPG image.

tools.name: infer_camera_pose
tools.description: Estimate camera pose from a single ArUco marker of known physical size. Returns rvec/tvec. Default intrinsics are coarse — supply your stand's camera matrix for accurate results.

tools.name: wait_for_marker
tools.description: Poll screenshots until an ArUco marker appears or timeout. Useful for gating AR test phases on physical-scene readiness.

serial.description: Device serial. Defaults to the selected device.

tools.name: list_avds
tools.description: List available Android Virtual Devices (emulator -list-avds).

tools.name: start_emulator
tools.description: Boot an Android emulator and wait until it registers with adb (up to 90s). Returns the emulator's serial.

tools.name: list_simulators
tools.description: List iOS Simulators via xcrun simctl. By default includes shutdown ones so they can be booted.

include_shutdown.description: Default true; set false for booted-only listing.

tools.name: boot_simulator
tools.description: Boot an iOS simulator by name (e.g. "iPhone 15") or UDID. Returns the booted Device — use its serial in select_device.

tools.name: stop_virtual_device
tools.description: Shut down an Android emulator (emulator-XXXX) or iOS simulator (UDID). Auto-detects by serial format.

serial.description: Emulator serial or simulator UDID.

tools.name: start_debug_session
tools.description: Boot `flutter run --machine` and wait for app.started. Requires the device lock for real devices. For Flutter WEB pass serial='chrome' (or 'web-server') — no lock needed; supports hot reload/restart, logs, lifecycle, and inspector tools (dump_widget_tree/render_tree, toggle_inspector) via the direct VM Service. NOTE: frame/heap timeline profiling isn't available on web (DWDS has no getVMTimeline).

serial.description: Defaults to selected device. Pass 'chrome' or 'web-server' for Flutter web (no device lock needed).

tools.name: stop_debug_session
tools.description: Stop a debug session. Defaults to the most-recently-started.

tools.name: restart_debug_session
tools.description: Hot reload (default) or hot restart (full_restart=true).

tools.name: list_debug_sessions
tools.description: List debug sessions. Also AUTO-RE-ATTACHES: sessions persist across an MCP-server restart, so this revives any whose VM Service is still reachable (and prunes the dead) — call it first after a restart to recover an orphaned session. Re-attached sessions are VM-Service-only (service extensions / dump_widget_tree / vm_evaluate work; hot reload does not).

tools.name: attach_debug_session
tools.description: Attach to an already-running app by its VM Service ws URI (from a debug session, `flutter run`, or your own probe) — no `flutter --machine` daemon needed. Probes reachability, then serves service extensions / dump_widget_tree / vm_evaluate over the direct VM Service. This is also the manual re-attach path after an MCP restart. Cannot hot reload (no daemon) — use start_debug_session for that.

vm_service_uri.description: The VM Service WebSocket URI, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:PORT/<token>=/ws

tools.name: read_debug_log
tools.description: Recent log slice from a debug session (app + daemon events). Filters by level and a window in seconds.

tools.name: tail_debug_log
tools.description: Wait until a regex matches a log line, or timeout.

tools.name: call_service_extension
tools.description: Call a registered VM service extension (ext.flutter.*). Returns the result and elapsed_ms.

tools.name: dump_widget_tree
tools.description: Convenience for ext.flutter.debugDumpApp.

tools.name: dump_render_tree
tools.description: Convenience for ext.flutter.debugDumpRenderTree.

tools.name: toggle_inspector
tools.description: Toggle the Flutter widget inspector overlay (ext.flutter.inspector.show).

tools.name: open_project_in_ide
tools.description: Open a project in a NEW VS Code window (`code -n <path>` by default). Tracks the spawned PID for later close.

tools.name: list_ide_windows
tools.description: List IDE windows opened by this MCP process.

tools.name: close_ide_window
tools.description: Close an IDE window by project_path or window_id.

tools.name: focus_ide_window
tools.description: Bring the IDE window to the foreground (macOS osascript).

tools.name: is_ide_available
tools.description: Returns the IDE version string if installed; else error.

tools.name: write_vscode_launch_config
tools.description: Write `.vscode/launch.json` for a Flutter project so F5 in VS Code mirrors the agent's debug session. Idempotent unless overwrite=true.

debug_mode.description: Default mode reflected in the active configuration.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file if true.

tools.name: setup_webdriveragent
tools.description: Build WebDriverAgent for an iOS device OR simulator (one-time per udid). Clones the repo if needed, runs `xcodebuild build-for-testing`. Simulators auto-detected (no signing); physical devices need team_id (or MCP_WDA_TEAM_ID env). Short-circuits if a previous build is recorded (unless skip_if_built=false).

skip_if_built.description: Default true; set false to force rebuild.

team_id.description: Apple Developer Team ID (10-char alphanumeric) for signing the WDA test runner. Required on physical devices. Falls back to MCP_WDA_TEAM_ID env var. Ignored for simulators.

is_simulator.description: Target is an iOS Simulator (builds with the simulator destination, no signing). Omit to auto-detect via `xcrun simctl`.

tools.name: start_wda_on_simulator
tools.description: Launch WebDriverAgent against an iOS simulator (detached) and wait for it to serve HTTP on `port`. Call this when `tap`/`swipe` returned next_action='start_wda_on_simulator'. Requires setup_webdriveragent to have run once. Returns when ready or fails clearly with the xcodebuild error.

port.description: WDA listen port. Default 8100. Override with MCP_IOS_SIM_WDA_PORT for global default.

ready_timeout_s.description: How long to wait for WDA to come up. Default 60.

tools.name: start_wda_on_device
tools.description: Launch WebDriverAgent on a PHYSICAL iPhone (detached) and wait until it answers over usbmux. Call when tap/swipe returned next_action='start_wda_on_device'. Requires setup_webdriveragent to have built+signed it once. Fixes physical-iOS input, which only works once WDA runs on-device.

udid.description: Physical device UDID (from list_devices / `pymobiledevice3 usbmux list`).

team_id.description: Apple Developer Team ID for the signed launch. Falls back to the MCP_WDA_TEAM_ID env var.

ready_timeout_s.description: How long to wait for WDA. Default 90 (device + CoreDevice tunnel bring-up is slower than a sim).

tools.name: dart_analyze
tools.description: [COMMODITY — prefer Google's dart_mcp_server.analyze_files when both MCPs are registered] Run `dart analyze --format=json` and return structured issues (severity, code, message, file, line, column). Optional min_severity filter.

tools.name: dart_format
tools.description: [COMMODITY — prefer Google's dart_mcp_server.dart_format when both MCPs are registered] Run `dart format` on a file or directory. dry_run=true reports what would change without rewriting.

tools.name: dart_fix
tools.description: [COMMODITY — prefer Google's dart_mcp_server.dart_fix when both MCPs are registered] Run `dart fix`. apply=false (default) is a dry-run; apply=true modifies files. Returns count of fixes + files changed.

tools.name: flutter_pub_get
tools.description: [COMMODITY — prefer Google's dart_mcp_server.pub when both MCPs are registered] Run `flutter pub get` to refresh dependencies.

tools.name: flutter_pub_outdated
tools.description: [COMMODITY — prefer Google's dart_mcp_server.pub with outdated subcommand when both MCPs are registered] Run `flutter pub outdated` to see stale dependencies.

tools.name: quality_gate
tools.description: Composite check before claiming 'done': dart analyze + dart format check + flutter unit tests. Returns overall_ok=true only when zero analyzer errors, format-clean (if required), and passing tests.

tools.name: patch_apply_safe
tools.description: Apply a unified diff to a git project; auto-rollback if quality_gate fails. Requires a clean working tree (or force=true). Leaves changes uncommitted for human review.

force.description: Apply even if working tree is dirty.

tools.name: narrate
tools.description: Turn an MCP envelope into a one-line prose summary. Useful for small models that need to echo results back to the user without re-parsing JSON.

tool.description: Optional tool name for richer phrasing.

tools.name: scaffold_feature
tools.description: Generate a Clean-Architecture skeleton (entity, failure, repo, use case, BLoC, page, tests) for a feature_name in snake_case. Idempotent unless overwrite=true.

tools.name: scaffold_patrol_test
tools.description: Emit a Patrol-4 web+mobile e2e SMOKE test into patrol_test/ (compile-verified against patrol 4.7.x). Widget-Key based so it's locale-independent; the same file runs on device and Chromium. Returns the run commands + wiring steps. Idempotent unless overwrite=true.

test_name.description: snake_case test id; file is <test_name>_test.dart. Default app_smoke.

root_widget.description: The app's root widget class in main.dart. Default MyApp.

tools.name: run_quick_check
tools.description: Fast health check: dart analyze + format check + git status. Skips unit tests; use quality_gate for the full bar.

tools.name: grep_logs
tools.description: Grep a saved log artifact for a regex with line context. Returns line numbers + before/after context for each match.

tools.name: summarize_session
tools.description: Boil the session trace down to a 3-line elevator pitch: headline, recent successes, recent errors.

tools.name: find_flutter_widget
tools.description: Scan lib/ for widget classes whose name matches a regex. Returns file paths + line numbers.

tools.name: list_missing_widget_keys
tools.description: Scan lib/ for tap-target widgets (Buttons, GestureDetector, InkWell, Switch, Checkbox, etc.) that lack a `key:` parameter. The single highest-leverage diagnostic for agents driving Flutter via Patrol or tap_text — selectors without Keys are the dominant source of test fragility (Drizz May 2026: 30-50% of Flutter QA time is selector maintenance). Returns file paths, line numbers, snippets.

target_widgets.description: Override the default tap-target widget set. Useful for codebases using custom button types.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Retrieve top-k chunks matching a query (skill, docs, code, or trace). Use instead of loading the whole SKILL — saves context for 4B agents.

tools.name: recall_corrective
tools.description: Recall + relevance grading + scope fallback. Use when the agent needs an answer it can trust; returns confidence and a diagnosis.

tools.name: index_project
tools.description: Walk a project, chunk md/dart/py files, push into Qdrant. Idempotent on (collection, source). Run once per project, or on a watcher.

tools.name: promote_sequence
tools.description: Tag a slice of the current session trace as a named, reusable skill. Skill names are snake_case, no spaces. Voyager-style skill library.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: Return every named skill in the library, ordered by use count. Use to discover what the agent has learned.

tools.name: replay_skill
tools.description: Re-execute a stored skill through the dispatcher. Records success/failure on the library so high-success skills get prioritised over time.

tools.name: calibrate_camera
tools.description: Calibrate camera intrinsics from chessboard images. Needs ≥3 images with a detected (cols x rows) inner-corner pattern. Returns fx/fy/cx/cy + distortion + reprojection error.

tools.name: assert_pose_stable
tools.description: Capture N pose samples of one ArUco marker and assert frame-to-frame stability under translation + rotation thresholds. Use to filter single-frame outliers before AR placement assertions.

serial.description: Defaults to selected device.

tools.name: wait_for_ar_session_ready
tools.description: Tail device logs until ARKit/ARCore reports normal tracking. Use as a gate before AR placement assertions.

serial.description: Defaults to selected device.

tools.name: vm_list_isolates
tools.description: List Dart isolates in the active debug session via the VM service WebSocket. Requires the [debug] extra (websockets).

tools.name: vm_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a Dart expression at a frame in an isolate of the active debug session. Defaults to the first runnable isolate and frame 0. Requires the [debug] extra.

tools.name: memory_summary
tools.description: Per-isolate memory usage on the running app: heap capacity, heap used, external (off-heap) bytes. Cheap checkpoint to call at start + end of a test loop.

tools.name: allocation_profile
tools.description: Per-class allocation breakdown. Pair with reset_accumulator=true at the start of a flow to detect leaks — classes that grew across the flow appear at the top of top_by_count.

reset_accumulator.description: Reset accumulator after snapshot — next call returns deltas since this checkpoint.

top_n.description: Top N by count + bytes. Default 20.

tools.name: detect_undisposed_controllers
tools.description: Counts live instances of leak-prone Flutter classes (TextEditingController, ScrollController, AnimationController, StreamSubscription, Timer, …). Returns plain-English advice on whether counts look healthy.

tools.name: find_retaining_path
tools.description: Why is class X still in memory? Walks GC roots → first live instance, returns the retainer chain (field-by-field path). Slow on large heaps (5-15s); use after detect_undisposed_controllers flags a class.

tools.name: take_heap_snapshot
tools.description: Save the full heap-graph snapshot to the session artifacts dir for later DevTools analysis. Use when allocation_profile shows growth but the cause isn't clear from the class names alone.

tools.name: analyze_app_size
tools.description: `flutter build … --analyze-size` wrapper: surfaces the top-N largest packages + assets in the release build, plus optional delta vs a baseline run. Pre-release store-listing gate.

mode.description: Default release. Non-release modes skip tree shaking — sizes are misleading.

baseline_json_path.description: Optional path to a previous --analyze-size JSON. When set, deltas_vs_baseline is populated.

tools.name: run_widget_test
tools.description: Targeted `flutter test` runner for widget tests. Filter by test_path (file or dir), name_pattern (regex or literal with plain_name=true), or tags. Same TestRun envelope as run_unit_tests. Pair coverage=true with test_coverage_report for the full coverage flow.

test_path.description: Single file or subdirectory (e.g. 'test/widgets/login_test.dart'). Omit to run all.

name_pattern.description: Pattern over the testWidgets() description. Regex by default; pass plain_name=true for literal substring matching.

plain_name.description: If true, name_pattern is a literal substring (--plain-name) instead of a regex.

update_goldens.description: DANGEROUS — overwrites golden images on mismatch. Use update_goldens tool instead for clarity.

platform.description: Test platform. 'auto' (default): VM, then retry on Chrome if a web-only library (dart:html) blocks the VM run. 'chrome': force Flutter web. 'vm': force VM.

tools.name: list_widget_tests
tools.description: Discover testWidgets() blocks under `test/` (or a custom root) without running them. Returns file + line + test name + golden flag. Use to plan which subset to run with run_widget_test.

tools.name: update_goldens
tools.description: ⚠️ Regenerate golden images for targeted widget tests. Use ONLY when you deliberately changed the visible output and want the new rendering accepted as the new baseline. Running unfiltered silently erases regression detection.

test_path.description: Strongly recommend targeting a specific file.

tools.name: test_coverage_report
tools.description: Runs `flutter test --coverage`, parses coverage/lcov.info, returns per-file + overall line coverage. Pair coverage_filter_prefix='lib/features/<x>/' to gate a single feature. Set fail_under to make the result.ok flag reflect a threshold check.

coverage_filter_prefix.description: Only files under this path (e.g. 'lib/features/auth/') are reported.

fail_under.description: Threshold 0.0-1.0. When set, passed_threshold=false if coverage falls below.

tools.name: start_frame_profile
tools.description: Begin VM Timeline collection for frame-rendering analysis. Pair with stop_frame_profile to bracket a specific user interaction (tap, scroll, animation). Returns the baseline timestamp + which streams are now enabled.

tools.name: stop_frame_profile
tools.description: Close the frame-profile bracket: disable Timeline, fetch captured events, analyze. Returns total + janked frame counts, P50/P90/P99/max frame times, worst-3 individual frames with build/raster split, and a paste-ready advice line. Always disables streams on exit (overhead ~5-10% CPU per stream).

tolerance_pct.description: Frames within this % of budget are NOT counted as jank. Default 0.10 (matches DevTools convention).

tools.name: propose_test_scenarios
tools.description: Returns a research-grounded test-scenario checklist for the project. Categorized (happy path / permission / network / accessibility / lifecycle / etc.), tagged with priority (P0/P1/P2) and the industry standard that motivates each. Inspects AndroidManifest, Info.plist, pubspec.yaml to add project-specific scenarios for detected features. See docs/testing-scenario-design.md for the full taxonomy + references.

app_description.description: Optional: 1-sentence description of what the app does. Used for keyword-matched ranking when supplied.

focus_areas.description: Narrow to specific categories. Values: happy_path, permission, network, input, interruption, lifecycle, accessibility, localization, device_matrix, performance, security, data.

top_n.description: Max scenarios returned. Default 25 — enough to be thorough, few enough to actually do.

tools.name: test_deep_link
tools.description: Fire a deep link at the device + optionally verify the right screen rendered. Android: `adb shell am start -W -a VIEW -d <uri>`. iOS simulator: `xcrun simctl openurl <udid> <uri>`. Physical iOS device deep links must come from Safari/Notes — out of scope. Returns launch_status, the launched activity (Android), and whether expect_screen_text was found.

expect_screen_text.description: If set, asserts this text is visible after the link fires.

serial.description: Device serial / UDID.

cold_start.description: Hint that you've stop_app'd before this call. Doesn't enforce — the agent is responsible for killing the app first if cold-start matters.

timeout_s.description: Max wait for launch + render. Default 15.

tools.name: pause_ui_automation
tools.description: Disables the openatx uiautomator2 helper APKs (com.github.uiautomator + .test) on Android via `pm disable-user`. Stops the AVD respawn-loop where the helper fights the app under test for foreground. MUST be paired with resume_ui_automation. Safe no-op when the helper isn't installed.

serial.description: Device serial; defaults to selected device.

tools.name: resume_ui_automation
tools.description: Re-enables the openatx uiautomator2 helper APKs via `pm enable`. Pair this with pause_ui_automation — every pause MUST be resumed. Waits settle_ms (default 800) after `pm enable` so the next uiautomator2 init can connect cleanly.

serial.description: Device serial; defaults to selected device.

settle_ms.description: Settle wait after pm enable. Default 800ms.

tools.name: audit_accessibility
tools.description: Walks the live UI tree, flags WCAG 2.2 violations. Checks tap-target size (SC 2.5.5), missing accessible labels (SC 4.1.2), disabled-but-clickable mismatches (SC 1.3.1). Returns findings sorted by severity (blocker → serious → minor), each citing the WCAG criterion + a Flutter-specific fix hint. EU EAA 2025 compliance gate for store listings.

serial.description: Device serial / UDID.

include_log_signals.description: Also scan last 30s of logs for RenderFlex overflow markers. Default true.

ignore_class_substrings.description: Class names containing any of these substrings are skipped (e.g. 'Divider' for purely decorative widgets). Defaults to ['Divider', 'Padding', 'SizedBox'].

tools.name: recommend_test_path
tools.description: Returns the canonical testing path for the given context. Picks from 7 strategies: pre_commit / pre_pr / daily_dev / nightly / pre_release / hotfix / postmortem. Each path returns a sequenced list of MCP tool calls with estimated timings, isolation guarantees, pass criteria, and skip conditions. See docs/testing-paths.md for the full taxonomy.

context.description: When in the dev cycle this runs.

device_serial.description: Optional explicit device. Else paths plan for 'first available' and let select_device pick.

size_baseline_path.description: Optional path to a previous --analyze-size JSON. Used by nightly + pre_release for delta reports.

coverage_fail_under.description: Coverage threshold for pre_pr / pre_release. Default 0.80.

tools.name: audit_code_seniority
tools.description: Grades a Flutter codebase against senior-engineer standards. Walks lib/*.dart with 24 rules across 4 tiers (junior / mid / senior / staff): print() leaks, business logic in widgets, missing dispose(), repos throwing instead of returning Either, monolithic Blocs, layering violations, orphan source files, missing super.key, and more. Returns per-file findings + overall grade + top_actions + preview_diffs for autofix-eligible rules. See docs/code-seniority-rubric.md for the full rubric.

paths.description: Optional subset of paths to scan (relative to project root). Default: ['lib'].

min_level.description: Minimum tier to flag. 'senior' suppresses junior+mid findings — useful on legacy code.

autofix.description: When true, populate preview_diffs with mechanical fixes (e.g. add super.key). Never writes files; just proposes.

tools.name: audit_security
tools.description: OWASP MASVS scanner. 20 rules across 3 severities (critical/high/medium): hardcoded API keys, JWT/PEM in source, cleartext HTTP, SharedPreferences for tokens, unguarded WebView JS, debug-signed release, ATS disabled, exported components, missing cert pinning. Returns per-file findings with redacted secrets + grade (secure/acceptable/at_risk/critical). See docs/security-rubric.md.

paths.description: Optional subset of paths to scan. Default: whole project.

tools.name: audit_performance
tools.description: Flutter jank audit (the gap Google's dart mcp-server doesn't cover). 10 rules across 3 severities over lib/: non-lazy ListView/GridView, setState in animation listeners, undisposed AnimationController, animated Opacity, shrinkWrap lists, Column-in-ScrollView lists, Image without cacheWidth, heavy work in build(), missing RepaintBoundary, zero-duration implicit animations. Returns per-file findings + grade (smooth/acceptable/janky/severe). Pure compute, no device. See docs/performance-rubric.md.

paths.description: Optional subset of paths to scan. Default: whole project.

tools.name: audit_localization
tools.description: i18n hygiene scanner. Walks lib/*.dart for hardcoded user-facing strings (Text, AppBar title, Tooltip, Button child, SnackBar, AlertDialog, hintText/labelText), parses lib/l10n/*.arb files, cross-references key usage, and checks MaterialApp's supportedLocales + localizationsDelegates + RTL plumbing. 16 rules across 4 tiers (junior/mid/senior/staff). Returns per-finding details + locales_detected + keys_total/used/unused + hardcoded_strings count + grade (well_localized / acceptable / single_locale / missing_l10n). See docs/localization-rubric.md.

paths.description: Optional subset of paths to scan. Default: ['lib'].

arb_dir.description: Override arb-file directory. Default tries lib/l10n then l10n.

tools.name: audit_dependencies
tools.description: Supply-chain audit. Walks pubspec.yaml + pubspec.lock + lib imports. 14 rules across 4 tiers: floating pins on security-sensitive packages, git/path overrides, dev tools in dependencies, unused declarations, transitive-as-direct, duplicates, deprecated packages, wide ranges, loose Flutter SDK, copyleft hints. Returns grade (clean/acceptable/at_risk/blocked). No network. See docs/dependencies-rubric.md.

is_published.description: When true (default), git:/path: overrides are flagged as serious. Set false for internal-only tools.

tools.name: audit_release_readiness
tools.description: Release-readiness gate. Composes the 4 v0.3.0 audit verticals (seniority, security, localization, dependencies) concurrently into one ship/hold/block verdict. Returns composite letter grade A-F, per-domain breakdown, cross-domain top_actions, and a paste-ready release-PR summary. Pure compute. Sub-second. See docs/release-readiness-rubric.md.

include_web_app.description: Default true. Audits web/ if present; auto-excluded on mobile-only projects.

maestro_report_path.description: Optional path to a Maestro JUnit XML or JSON report. When provided, adds a test_execution domain to the composite.

maestro_prior_report_path.description: Optional prior Maestro report for regression detection (passed-then-failed).

lighthouse_report_path.description: Optional path to a Lighthouse JSON report. When provided, adds a web_vitals domain to the composite.

weight_test_execution.description: Default 1.5. Only active if maestro_report_path set.

tools.name: design_test_plan
tools.description: Senior-tester pre-write discipline. Given a user story / ACs / source paths, returns a structured plan: per-AC happy/negative/boundary cases (EP + BVA) with should_X_when_Y names, cross-cutting requirements (a11y, l10n, lifecycle), test layer recommendations, test data factory shapes, exploratory charter. Engages gap protocol when ACs missing — proceeds with synthesised ACs and logs notes_for_afterwork. Pure compute. See docs/senior-tester-discipline.md.

acceptance_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria as a list of strings. Optional but recommended.

source_paths.description: Source paths if reverse-engineering ACs from implementation.

team_style.description: Determines whether Gherkin E2E is recommended.

tools.name: audit_test_quality
tools.description: Post-write test-suite audit. Walks test/ + integration_test/ for 28 rules across 4 tiers: bare_pump, await_missing_on_pump, vacuous_expect, sleep_in_test, mocked_sut, network_call_unmocked, firestore_instance_unmocked, golden_no_verified, missing_failure_path, e2e_doing_unit_work, widget_test_no_provider, nondeterministic_random_seed, and more. Returns grade (excellent/acceptable/fragile/unreliable). Pure compute. Sister to design_test_plan. See docs/test-quality-rubric.md.

paths.description: Optional subset of test paths to scan. Default: ['test', 'integration_test'].

tools.name: audit_maestro_flow
tools.description: Lint Maestro YAML flows with senior-tester discipline. 12 rules across 4 tiers: hardcoded_locale_string (Polish-phone lesson in YAML form), vacuous_assertion (assertVisible '.*'), sleep_in_flow (wait: 3000 instead of waitForAnimationToEnd), no_assertions, no_appId, no_tags, missing_failure_path, nested_runFlow_deep, hardcoded_credentials, and more. Pure compute. The composition play: Maestro's MCP authors + executes flows; we audit them. See docs/maestro-flow-rubric.md.

paths.description: Optional subset of paths to scan. Default tries .maestro/, maestro/, tests/maestro/, test/maestro/.

tools.name: ingest_maestro_report
tools.description: Parse Maestro execution report (JUnit XML or JSON), surface pass/fail/flaky counts, runtimes, regressions vs prior report. Returns grade (clean/acceptable/at_risk/blocked), per-flow execution detail, top_failures, advice. Pure compute. Stdlib parsers only. Pairs with audit_maestro_flow (lint) and Maestro's own run tool — we audit the report, they run the flows.

report_path.description: Path to Maestro JUnit XML, JSON, or a directory containing one.

prior_report_path.description: Optional path to a prior report for regression detection (passed-then-failed).

tools.name: audit_web_app
tools.description: Flutter web production-readiness audit. Walks web/index.html + web/manifest.json + web/_headers. 12 rules across 4 tiers: html_no_lang_attr, no_viewport_meta, placeholder_meta_description, no_favicon, no_csp, no_theme_color, manifest_missing_pwa_fields, manifest_no_maskable_icon, placeholder_app_name, no_seo_meta, no_apple_touch_icon, no_loading_indicator. Returns grade (excellent/acceptable/needs_polish/not_production_ready/not_web_app). Pure compute. See docs/web-app-rubric.md.

tools.name: ingest_lighthouse_report
tools.description: Parse a Lighthouse JSON report. Returns category scores (performance/accessibility/seo/pwa), Core Web Vitals (LCP/CLS/TBT/FCP/TTI), top opportunities, and a grade (good/needs_improvement/poor/blocked). CanvasKit-aware perf threshold (default 70). Pure compute — you run lighthouse, we parse it. See docs/web-app-rubric.md.

report_path.description: Path to a Lighthouse JSON report, or a directory containing one.

perf_good_threshold.description: Perf score considered 'good'. Default 70 (CanvasKit-aware). Raise for HTML/wasm renderer.

tools.name: ingest_har
tools.description: Parse a HAR (Network-panel export from a browser MCP) into a per-action network-cost report: per-host request counts, reads vs writes, latency p50/p95, payload bytes, errors, and the slowest calls — with one backend host highlighted (e.g. firestore.googleapis.com or a REST API). Grade (good/needs_improvement/poor/blocked). Pure compute — you capture, we grade. See docs/web-logged-in-flow.md.

har_path.description: Path to a .har file (or a directory containing one).

backend_host.description: Highlight this backend host (substring match). Omit to auto-pick the busiest non-CDN host.

slow_ms.description: Threshold (ms) for the slowest-calls list. Default 1000.

tools.name: ingest_frame_timeline
tools.description: Grade a captured frame timeline into a jank score — the runtime complement to audit_performance. Accepts a Trace Event Format file (Flutter VM Timeline from start/stop_frame_profile, or a Chrome DevTools web trace) or a frames_ms list. Returns frame count, % janky (over the fps budget), worst frame, p50/p90/p99, build-vs-raster, and a grade (smooth/acceptable/janky/severe). Pure compute. See docs/performance-rubric.md.

timeline_path.description: Path to a trace/timeline JSON (or a directory).

fps.description: Target FPS; frame budget = 1000/fps. Default 60 (pass 120 for ProMotion).

severe_factor.description: A frame this many times over budget is 'severe'. Default 2.0.

tools.name: estimate_tokens
tools.description: Estimate token cost of text or a file before ingesting it. Returns chars, tokens (low–high band), and size_class. Pass budget_tokens for a fits/headroom verdict and a recommendation (proceed/caution/flush). Pure compute. SLM context guard.

text.description: Text to estimate. Provide this OR `path`.

path.description: Path to a file to estimate. Provide this OR `text`. Files over 25 MB are estimated from byte size without loading.

budget_tokens.description: Your remaining context budget. When set, the result reports fits/headroom and a recommendation.

chars_per_token.description: Heuristic avg chars/token. ~4 for prose, ~3.3 for code/JSON. Default 4.0. Ignored when tiktoken runs.

tools.name: run_lighthouse
tools.description: Run Lighthouse against a URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080) and parse it in one call: category scores, Core Web Vitals (LCP/CLS/TBT), top opportunities, CanvasKit-aware grade. Needs the lighthouse CLI (or npx) + Chrome. The runner companion to ingest_lighthouse_report; saves the JSON for re-ingest. See docs/web-app-rubric.md.

url.description: URL to audit, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (serve a `flutter build web` first).

output_path.description: Where to save the JSON report. Omit for a temp file (the path is returned for re-ingest).

categories.description: Restrict to categories, e.g. ['performance','accessibility']. Omit for all.

preset.description: Lighthouse preset. Default is mobile/throttled; use 'desktop' for a desktop Flutter web build.

timeout_s.description: Max seconds for the Lighthouse run. Default 180.

tools.name: save_golden_image
tools.description: Capture a screenshot and save it under <project>/tests/fixtures/golden/<label>.png (or under the session artifacts if no project_path). Bootstraps goldens for compare_screenshot regression tests.

serial.description: Defaults to selected device.

tools.name: new_session
tools.description: Create a new artifacts session directory.

tools.name: fetch_artifact
tools.description: Read a previously emitted artifact by path. Returns text content or, for binary files, metadata + sha256. Use after a tool returned data_truncated=true.

path.description: Absolute path returned by an earlier tool.

tools.name: get_artifacts_dir
tools.description: Return the current artifacts directory.
